CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.seo_canonical_rows()
 RETURNS TABLE(slug text, entity_type text, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET work_mem TO '16MB'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RETURN QUERY
 SELECT DISTINCT ON(k.name_key,k.city_key,k.region_key,k.country_key,k.address_key,k.entity_type)
 k.slug,k.entity_type,k.updated_at FROM zoi.seo_identity_keys k WHERE k.is_indexable
 ORDER BY k.name_key,k.city_key,k.region_key,k.country_key,k.address_key,k.entity_type,
 k.completeness DESC,k.ugly,k.updated_at DESC,k.slug;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.maintain_seo_projection()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN UPDATE zoi.seo_identity_keys k SET slug=NEW.slug,entity_type=NEW.entity_type,updated_at=coalesce(NEW.updated_at,NEW.created_at),
 completeness=(((NEW.address IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.phone IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.website IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.latitude IS NOT NULL)::int)+((NEW.description IS NOT NULL)::int)),
 ugly=(NEW.slug ~ '-[0-9a-f]{6}$')::int,
 is_indexable=coalesce(NEW.publish_status='published' AND NEW.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared') AND coalesce(NEW.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden'
 AND nullif(btrim(NEW.slug),'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(btrim(NEW.name),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND (NEW.city IS NOT NULL OR NEW.address IS NOT NULL OR NEW.website IS NOT NULL),false)
WHERE k.listing_id=NEW.id;
 RETURN NEW; END $function$

seo_triggers: CREATE TRIGGER maintain_seo_identity_keys AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF id, name, city, region, country, address ON zoi.listings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION zoi.maintain_seo_identity_keys()

CREATE TRIGGER zz_maintain_seo_projection AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF id, name, city, region, country, address, slug, entity_type, updated_at, created_at, phone, website, latitude, description, publish_status, moderation_status, marketplace_status ON zoi.listings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION zoi.maintain_seo_projection()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.seo_entity(p_slug text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH me AS (
  SELECT l.* FROM zoi.listings l WHERE l.slug=p_slug AND l.publish_status='published' AND l.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared')
   AND coalesce(l.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden' LIMIT 1
 ), canon AS (
  SELECT l2.slug FROM zoi.listings l2,me
  WHERE l2.publish_status='published' AND l2.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared') AND coalesce(l2.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden' AND nullif(btrim(l2.slug),'') IS NOT NULL
   AND l2.entity_type=me.entity_type
   AND md5(zoi.seo_name(l2.name,l2.city))=md5(zoi.seo_name(me.name,me.city))
   AND md5(zoi.seo_text(l2.city))=md5(zoi.seo_text(me.city)) AND zoi.seo_name(l2.name,l2.city)=zoi.seo_name(me.name,me.city)
   AND zoi.seo_text(l2.city)=zoi.seo_text(me.city) AND zoi.seo_text(l2.region)=zoi.seo_text(me.region)
   AND zoi.seo_text(l2.country)=zoi.seo_text(me.country) AND zoi.seo_text(l2.address)=zoi.seo_text(me.address)
  ORDER BY (((l2.address IS NOT NULL)::int)+((l2.phone IS NOT NULL)::int)+((l2.website IS NOT NULL)::int)+((l2.latitude IS NOT NULL)::int)+((l2.description IS NOT NULL)::int)) DESC,
   (l2.slug ~ '-[0-9a-f]{6}$')::int,coalesce(l2.updated_at,l2.created_at) DESC,l2.slug LIMIT 1
 )
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',me.id,'name',me.name,'entity_type',me.entity_type,'slug',me.slug,
  'canonical_slug',(SELECT slug FROM canon),'city',me.city,'country',me.country,'address',me.address,'phone',me.phone,
  'email',me.email,'photo_url',me.photo_url,'publish_status',me.publish_status,'moderation_status',me.moderation_status,'marketplace_status',me.marketplace_status,'website',me.website,'description',me.description,'latitude',me.latitude,'longitude',me.longitude,
  'rating',me.rating,'rating_count',me.rating_count,'price_range',me.price_range,'meta_title',me.meta_title,'meta_description',me.meta_description,
  'geo_precision',me.geo_precision,'social_links',me.social_links,'profile',me.profile,'category_slug',(SELECT c.slug FROM zoi.categories c WHERE c.id=me.primary_category_id),
  'place_path',CASE WHEN me.place_id IS NOT NULL THEN zoi.place_path(me.place_id) ELSE NULL END,'updated_at',coalesce(me.updated_at,me.created_at)) || zoi.public_home_actions(me.id) || jsonb_build_object('owner_content',zoi.public_owner_content(me.id)) FROM me;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.reviewed_food_public_context(l zoi.listings)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE q jsonb:=coalesce(l.profile->'_enrich','{}'::jsonb);identity jsonb;bound jsonb;actual jsonb;valid boolean;held boolean;projected jsonb:=l.profile;
BEGIN
 identity:=q->'source_identity';bound:=identity->'canonical_context';
 actual:=jsonb_build_object('listing_id',l.id,'name',l.name,'entity_type',l.entity_type,'website',l.website,'address',l.address,'city',l.city,'country',l.country,
  'category_slug',(SELECT c.slug FROM zoi.categories c WHERE c.id=l.primary_category_id),'primary_category_id',l.primary_category_id,'owner_user_id',l.owner_user_id,'owner_workspace_id',l.owner_workspace_id,'claim_status',l.claim_status);
 valid:=coalesce(identity->>'verification'='reviewed_official_visible_branch' AND jsonb_typeof(bound)='object' AND bound=actual
  AND l.owner_user_id IS NULL AND l.owner_workspace_id IS NULL AND (l.claim_status IS NULL OR l.claim_status='unclaimed')
  AND l.entity_type IN('business','vendor') AND actual->>'category_slug'~*'(restaurant|taverna|baker)'
  AND identity->>'name'=l.name AND identity->>'expected_entity_type'=l.entity_type AND identity->>'category_slug'=actual->>'category_slug'
  AND q->>'source_url'=l.website AND rtrim(identity->>'source_url','/')=rtrim(l.website,'/')
  AND identity->>'review_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND q#>>'{provenance,source_identity}'='reviewed_official_visible_branch#sha256='||(identity->>'review_sha256')
  AND q#>>'{food_source_coverage,identity_verification}'='reviewed_official_visible_branch' AND q#>>'{food_source_coverage,identity_review_sha256}'=identity->>'review_sha256',false);
 held:=coalesce(q->>'blocked','false')='true' OR coalesce(q->>'status','')='blocked' OR coalesce(q->>'crawl_status','')='blocked'
  OR (q->>'crawl_status'='error' AND coalesce(q->>'last_error','')<>'reviewed_visible_food_requires_review')
  OR coalesce(q->>'blocked_reason','')='source_scope_mismatch'
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['scope_review_required','organization_identity_quarantine','source_scope_mismatch','source_challenge','challenge'])k WHERE q->>k='true')
  OR coalesce(q->>'identity_scope','')<>'' OR q ? 'member' OR q ? 'association_member' OR q ? 'source_affiliation'
  OR coalesce(q->>'source_kind','') IN('association_directory','association_member','supporting_publisher_profile');
 IF NOT valid OR held THEN
  projected:=jsonb_set(coalesce(l.profile,'{}'::jsonb),'{_enrich}',q||jsonb_build_object('blocked',true,'blocked_reason','source_scope_mismatch','scope_review_required',true),true);
 ELSIF q->>'crawl_status'='error' AND q->>'last_error'='reviewed_visible_food_requires_review'
  AND coalesce(q->>'blocked','false')<>'true' AND coalesce(q->>'status','')<>'blocked'
  AND coalesce(q->>'blocked_reason','')<>'source_scope_mismatch'
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['scope_review_required','organization_identity_quarantine','source_scope_mismatch','source_challenge','challenge'])k WHERE q->>k='true') THEN
  -- This is a manual review deferral, not a new successful source crawl. Keep
  -- old proof and dates unchanged; older public consumers understand a nonerror
  -- review-required state without hiding the still-current receipt's facts.
  projected:=jsonb_set(l.profile,'{_enrich,crawl_status}','"review_required"'::jsonb,false);
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('current',valid,'profile',projected);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geo_precision_canon(p_raw text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case lower(nullif(trim(coalesce(p_raw, '')), ''))
    when 'rooftop' then 'street'
    when 'address' then 'street'
    when 'street' then 'street'
    when 'neighborhood' then 'neighbourhood'
    when 'neighbourhood' then 'neighbourhood'
    when 'suburb' then 'neighbourhood'
    when 'locality' then 'city'
    when 'town' then 'city'
    when 'city' then 'city'
    when 'region' then 'region'
    when 'country' then 'region'
    when 'approx' then 'approximate'
    when 'approximate' then 'approximate'
    else 'unknown'
  end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geo_effective_precision(p_column text, p_geo jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE
 WHEN lower(btrim(p_geo->>'method')) ~ '^[[:space:]]*(city|town|village)[[:space:]]+(centroid|centre|center)[[:space:]]*$' THEN 'city'
 WHEN lower(btrim(p_geo->>'method')) ~ '^[[:space:]]*(country|region)[[:space:]]+(centroid|centre|center)[[:space:]]*$' THEN 'region'
 ELSE CASE WHEN zoi.geo_precision_canon(p_column)='unknown' THEN zoi.geo_precision_canon(p_geo->>'precision') ELSE zoi.geo_precision_canon(p_column) END END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.geo_country_canon(p_raw text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case lower(nullif(trim(coalesce(p_raw, '')), ''))
    when 'us' then 'United States'
    when 'usa' then 'United States'
    when 'u.s.' then 'United States'
    when 'u.s.a.' then 'United States'
    when 'united states of america' then 'United States'
    when 'uk' then 'United Kingdom'
    when 'great britain' then 'United Kingdom'
    when 'gb' then 'United Kingdom'
    when 'uae' then 'United Arab Emirates'
    when 'gr' then 'Greece'
    when 'el' then 'Greece'
    when 'ca' then 'Canada'
    when 'au' then 'Australia'
    when 'nz' then 'New Zealand'
    when 'cy' then 'Cyprus'
    else nullif(trim(p_raw), '')
  end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.explore_default_page(p_limit integer, p_offset integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
 WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT candidate.id,candidate.name,candidate.verification_status,candidate.trust_score,0 AS name_relevance
  FROM zoi.listings candidate
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT duplicate.id FROM zoi.listings duplicate
   WHERE duplicate.publish_status='published' AND duplicate.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared') AND coalesce(duplicate.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden'
    AND lower(trim(coalesce(duplicate.name,'')))=lower(trim(coalesce(candidate.name,'')))
    AND lower(trim(coalesce(duplicate.city,'')))=lower(trim(coalesce(candidate.city,'')))
    AND lower(trim(coalesce(zoi.geo_country_canon(duplicate.country),'')))=lower(trim(coalesce(zoi.geo_country_canon(candidate.country),'')))
   ORDER BY (duplicate.verification_status='verified') DESC,duplicate.trust_score DESC NULLS LAST,
    CASE duplicate.entity_type WHEN 'creator' THEN 0 WHEN 'artist' THEN 1 WHEN 'business' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    duplicate.name,duplicate.id
   LIMIT 1
  ) winner
  WHERE candidate.publish_status='published' AND candidate.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared') AND coalesce(candidate.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden' AND winner.id=candidate.id
  ORDER BY (candidate.verification_status='verified') DESC,candidate.trust_score DESC NULLS LAST,candidate.name,candidate.id
  LIMIT least(greatest(p_limit,1),48) OFFSET greatest(p_offset,0)
 )
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'_sort_verified'-'_sort_trust'-'_sort_relevance'
  ORDER BY r._sort_relevance,r._sort_verified DESC,r._sort_trust DESC NULLS LAST,r.name,r.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM (
  SELECT l.id,l.slug,l.name,
   zoi.public_listing_card_description(l.entity_type,card.media_input) AS description,
   card.media_input,
   c.label_en AS category,l.entity_type,l.city,zoi.geo_country_canon(l.country) AS country,
   l.region,l.region_code,l.region_native,
   '/'||replace(l.entity_type,'travel_place','travel-place')||'/'||l.slug AS path,
   l.verification_status,l.rating,
   zoi.public_listing_card_photo(card.media_input) AS photo_url,
   CASE WHEN l.profile->>'hero_kind'='event_poster' AND zoi.public_listing_card_photo(card.media_input)=l.profile->>'hero_url' THEN 'event_poster' ELSE NULL END AS image_kind,
   (l.owner_workspace_id IS NULL AND coalesce(l.claim_status,'unclaimed') NOT IN ('claimed','approved')) AS claimable,
   page.name_relevance AS _sort_relevance,(page.verification_status='verified') AS _sort_verified,page.trust_score AS _sort_trust
  FROM page JOIN zoi.listings l ON l.id=page.id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT zoi.public_listing_card_input(l.id,l.website,l.photo_url,l.description,l.profile) AS media_input OFFSET 0) card
  LEFT JOIN zoi.categories c ON c.id=l.primary_category_id
 ) r;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.explore_search_before_default_page(p_q text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_city text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_country text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 24, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_region text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_q text:=lower(btrim(coalesce(p_q,'')));
 v_pattern text:='%'||replace(replace(replace(v_q,chr(92),chr(92)||chr(92)),'%',chr(92)||'%'),'_',chr(92)||'_')||'%';
BEGIN
 -- Only literal nonempty city filters take the bounded locality-first path.
 -- Pattern and escape semantics continue through the original global query.
 IF p_city IS NOT NULL AND p_city<>'' AND strpos(p_city,'%')=0
  AND strpos(p_city,'_')=0 AND strpos(p_city,chr(92))=0 THEN
 RETURN (WITH locality AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.id,l.name,l.verification_status,l.trust_score,l.city,l.country,l.entity_type,
   l.search_tsv,l.region,l.region_native,l.region_code
  FROM zoi.listings l
  WHERE l.publish_status='published' AND l.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared')
   AND coalesce(l.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden'
   AND lower(l.city)=lower(p_city) AND l.city ILIKE p_city
   AND (p_type IS NULL OR p_type='' OR l.entity_type=p_type)
   AND (p_country IS NULL OR p_country='' OR zoi.geo_country_canon(l.country) ILIKE p_country)
   AND (p_country IS NULL OR p_country='' OR strpos(p_country,'%')>0 OR strpos(p_country,'_')>0
    OR strpos(p_country,chr(92))>0 OR lower(zoi.geo_country_canon(l.country))=lower(p_country))
   AND (p_region IS NULL OR p_region='' OR l.region ILIKE p_region
    OR l.region_native ILIKE p_region OR upper(l.region_code)=upper(p_region))
 ), ranked AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.id,l.name,l.verification_status,l.trust_score,
   CASE WHEN v_q='' THEN 0 WHEN lower(btrim(l.name))=v_q THEN 0
    WHEN left(lower(btrim(l.name)),length(v_q))=v_q THEN 1
    WHEN v_q=ANY(regexp_split_to_array(lower(l.name),'[^[:alnum:]_]+')) THEN 2
    WHEN strpos(lower(l.name),v_q)>0 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS name_relevance,
   row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY lower(trim(coalesce(l.name,''))),lower(trim(coalesce(l.city,''))),
     lower(trim(coalesce(zoi.geo_country_canon(l.country),'')))
    ORDER BY (l.verification_status='verified') DESC,l.trust_score DESC NULLS LAST,
     CASE l.entity_type WHEN 'creator' THEN 0 WHEN 'artist' THEN 1 WHEN 'business' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
     l.name,l.id
   ) AS dedupe_rank
  FROM locality l
  WHERE (v_q='' OR l.search_tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('simple',v_q)
    OR lower(l.name) LIKE v_pattern OR lower(l.region) LIKE v_pattern
    OR lower(l.region_native) LIKE v_pattern)
   AND (p_type IS NULL OR p_type='' OR l.entity_type=p_type)
   AND (p_city IS NULL OR p_city='' OR l.city ILIKE p_city)
   AND (p_country IS NULL OR p_country='' OR zoi.geo_country_canon(l.country) ILIKE p_country)
   AND (p_region IS NULL OR p_region='' OR l.region ILIKE p_region
    OR l.region_native ILIKE p_region OR upper(l.region_code)=upper(p_region))
 ), page AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id,name,verification_status,trust_score,name_relevance
  FROM ranked WHERE dedupe_rank=1
  ORDER BY name_relevance,(verification_status='verified') DESC,trust_score DESC NULLS LAST,name,id
  LIMIT least(greatest(p_limit,1),48) OFFSET greatest(p_offset,0)
 )
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'_sort_verified'-'_sort_trust'-'_sort_relevance'
  ORDER BY r._sort_relevance,r._sort_verified DESC,r._sort_trust DESC NULLS LAST,r.name,r.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM (
  SELECT l.id,l.slug,l.name,
   zoi.public_listing_card_description(l.entity_type,card.media_input) AS description,
   card.media_input,
   c.label_en AS category,l.entity_type,l.city,zoi.geo_country_canon(l.country) AS country,
   l.region,l.region_code,l.region_native,
   '/'||replace(l.entity_type,'travel_place','travel-place')||'/'||l.slug AS path,
   l.verification_status,l.rating,
   zoi.public_listing_card_photo(card.media_input) AS photo_url,
   CASE WHEN l.profile->>'hero_kind'='event_poster' AND zoi.public_listing_card_photo(card.media_input)=l.profile->>'hero_url' THEN 'event_poster' ELSE NULL END AS image_kind,
   (l.owner_workspace_id IS NULL AND coalesce(l.claim_status,'unclaimed') NOT IN ('claimed','approved')) AS claimable,
   page.name_relevance AS _sort_relevance,(page.verification_status='verified') AS _sort_verified,page.trust_score AS _sort_trust
  FROM page JOIN zoi.listings l ON l.id=page.id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT zoi.public_listing_card_input(l.id,l.website,l.photo_url,l.description,l.profile) AS media_input OFFSET 0) card
  LEFT JOIN zoi.categories c ON c.id=l.primary_category_id
 ) r);
 END IF;
 RETURN (WITH ranked AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT l.id,l.name,l.verification_status,l.trust_score,
   CASE WHEN v_q='' THEN 0 WHEN lower(btrim(l.name))=v_q THEN 0
    WHEN left(lower(btrim(l.name)),length(v_q))=v_q THEN 1
    WHEN v_q=ANY(regexp_split_to_array(lower(l.name),'[^[:alnum:]_]+')) THEN 2
    WHEN strpos(lower(l.name),v_q)>0 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS name_relevance,
   row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY lower(trim(coalesce(l.name,''))),lower(trim(coalesce(l.city,''))),
     lower(trim(coalesce(zoi.geo_country_canon(l.country),'')))
    ORDER BY (l.verification_status='verified') DESC,l.trust_score DESC NULLS LAST,
     CASE l.entity_type WHEN 'creator' THEN 0 WHEN 'artist' THEN 1 WHEN 'business' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
     l.name,l.id
   ) AS dedupe_rank
  FROM zoi.listings l
  WHERE l.publish_status='published' AND l.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared')
   AND coalesce(l.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden'
   AND (v_q='' OR l.search_tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('simple',v_q)
    OR lower(l.name) LIKE v_pattern OR lower(l.region) LIKE v_pattern
    OR lower(l.region_native) LIKE v_pattern)
   AND (p_type IS NULL OR p_type='' OR l.entity_type=p_type)
   AND (p_city IS NULL OR p_city='' OR l.city ILIKE p_city)
   AND (p_country IS NULL OR p_country='' OR zoi.geo_country_canon(l.country) ILIKE p_country)
   AND (p_region IS NULL OR p_region='' OR l.region ILIKE p_region
    OR l.region_native ILIKE p_region OR upper(l.region_code)=upper(p_region))
 ), page AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT id,name,verification_status,trust_score,name_relevance
  FROM ranked WHERE dedupe_rank=1
  ORDER BY name_relevance,(verification_status='verified') DESC,trust_score DESC NULLS LAST,name,id
  LIMIT least(greatest(p_limit,1),48) OFFSET greatest(p_offset,0)
 )
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'_sort_verified'-'_sort_trust'-'_sort_relevance'
  ORDER BY r._sort_relevance,r._sort_verified DESC,r._sort_trust DESC NULLS LAST,r.name,r.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM (
  SELECT l.id,l.slug,l.name,
   zoi.public_listing_card_description(l.entity_type,card.media_input) AS description,
   card.media_input,
   c.label_en AS category,l.entity_type,l.city,zoi.geo_country_canon(l.country) AS country,
   l.region,l.region_code,l.region_native,
   '/'||replace(l.entity_type,'travel_place','travel-place')||'/'||l.slug AS path,
   l.verification_status,l.rating,
   zoi.public_listing_card_photo(card.media_input) AS photo_url,
   CASE WHEN l.profile->>'hero_kind'='event_poster' AND zoi.public_listing_card_photo(card.media_input)=l.profile->>'hero_url' THEN 'event_poster' ELSE NULL END AS image_kind,
   (l.owner_workspace_id IS NULL AND coalesce(l.claim_status,'unclaimed') NOT IN ('claimed','approved')) AS claimable,
   page.name_relevance AS _sort_relevance,(page.verification_status='verified') AS _sort_verified,page.trust_score AS _sort_trust
  FROM page JOIN zoi.listings l ON l.id=page.id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT zoi.public_listing_card_input(l.id,l.website,l.photo_url,l.description,l.profile) AS media_input OFFSET 0) card
  LEFT JOIN zoi.categories c ON c.id=l.primary_category_id
 ) r);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.explore_geo(p_limit integer DEFAULT 5000, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(slug text, entity_type text, name text, city text, country text, category_slug text, lat double precision, lng double precision, geo_precision text, address text, id uuid, geo_metadata jsonb, reviewed_destination jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 WITH page AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT l.id FROM zoi.listings l WHERE l.publish_status='published'AND l.moderation_status IN('clean','cleared')AND l.duplicate_status<>'confirmed_duplicate'AND coalesce(l.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden'AND l.latitude IS NOT NULL AND l.longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.id LIMIT least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,5000),1),5000)OFFSET greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0)
 ),records AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT l.id,l.slug,l.entity_type,l.name,l.city,l.country,l.primary_category_id,l.latitude,l.longitude,l.geo_precision,l.address,l.profile->'_geo'AS geo,l.profile->'_enrich'AS scope FROM page p JOIN zoi.listings l ON l.id=p.id
 )
 SELECT l.slug::text,l.entity_type::text,l.name::text,l.city::text,zoi.geo_country_canon(l.country)::text,c.slug::text,l.latitude::double precision,l.longitude::double precision,zoi.geo_effective_precision(l.geo_precision::text,l.geo),l.address::text,l.id,
 jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('scope_conflict',coalesce(l.scope->>'source_scope_mismatch'='true'OR l.scope->>'scope_review_required'='true'OR l.scope->>'organization_identity_quarantine'='true'OR l.scope->>'blocked_reason'='source_scope_mismatch'OR(l.scope->>'identity_scope'='organization'AND l.entity_type IN('artist','creator','professional'))OR l.scope->>'source_kind'='association_member',false),'method',left(regexp_replace(l.geo->>'method','[^[:alnum:] _-]','','g'),120),'precision',left(regexp_replace(l.geo->>'precision','[^[:alnum:] _-]','','g'),40),'source',CASE WHEN l.geo->>'source'~'^[a-zA-Z0-9 _-]{1,80}$'THEN l.geo->>'source'END,'geocoded_at',CASE WHEN l.geo->>'geocoded_at'~'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}([T ][0-9:.+Z-]+)?$'THEN left(l.geo->>'geocoded_at',40)END)),
 CASE WHEN l.geo_precision::text='street'AND nullif(l.geo->>'request_id','')IS NOT NULL THEN public.geography_reviewed_point(l.id)END
 FROM records l LEFT JOIN zoi.categories c ON c.id=l.primary_category_id ORDER BY l.id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.explore_geo(p_q text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_city text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_country text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 600)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM(
 SELECT l.id,l.name,COALESCE(l.canonical_path,'/p/'||l.slug) AS path,l.latitude AS lat,l.longitude AS lng,l.entity_type,l.city,(l.verification_status='verified') AS verified
 FROM zoi.listings l WHERE l.publish_status='published' AND l.moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared') AND COALESCE(l.marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden' AND l.latitude IS NOT NULL AND l.longitude IS NOT NULL
 AND(p_type IS NULL OR l.entity_type=p_type) AND(p_city IS NULL OR l.city ILIKE p_city) AND(p_country IS NULL OR l.country ILIKE p_country)
 AND(p_q IS NULL OR l.name ILIKE '%'||p_q||'%' OR l.search_tsv @@ pg_catalog.plainto_tsquery('pg_catalog.simple',p_q))
 ORDER BY(l.verification_status='verified') DESC,l.trust_score DESC NULLS LAST,l.id
 LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(p_limit,1),1200))r
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.explore_search(p_q text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_city text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_country text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 24, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_region text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Keep large-offset work on the original set-based query; the indexed probe
 -- path improves initial discovery without making deep paging more expensive.
 IF lower(btrim(coalesce(p_q,'')))='' AND coalesce(p_type,'')='' AND coalesce(p_city,'')='' AND coalesce(p_country,'')='' AND coalesce(p_region,'')='' AND greatest(p_offset,0)<=240 THEN
  RETURN zoi.explore_default_page(p_limit,p_offset);
 END IF;
 RETURN zoi.explore_search_before_default_page(p_q,p_type,p_city,p_country,p_limit,p_offset,p_region);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.schema_type(p_entity text, p_cat text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_entity='event' then 'Event'
    when p_entity='church' then 'Church'
    when p_entity='school' then 'EducationalOrganization'
    when p_entity='organization' then 'Organization'
    when p_entity='venue' then 'EventVenue'
    when p_entity in ('creator','artist') then 'Person'
    when p_entity='travel_place' then 'TouristAttraction'
    when p_entity='product' then 'Product'
    when p_entity='vendor' then 'Store'
    when p_entity='professional' then case p_cat
         when 'lawyers' then 'Attorney' when 'dentists' then 'Dentist'
         when 'doctors' then 'Physician' when 'accountants' then 'AccountingService'
         when 'realtors' then 'RealEstateAgent' when 'insurance' then 'InsuranceAgency'
         else 'ProfessionalService' end
    when p_entity='business' then case p_cat
         when 'restaurants' then 'Restaurant' when 'tavernas' then 'Restaurant'
         when 'bakeries' then 'Bakery' when 'cafes' then 'CafeOrCoffeeShop'
         when 'groceries' then 'GroceryStore' when 'specialty-food' then 'GroceryStore'
         else 'LocalBusiness' end
    else 'LocalBusiness' end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.seo_pluralize(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case
    when p ~ '(ch|sh|s|x|z)$' then p||'es'
    when p ~ '[^aeiou]y$'     then regexp_replace(p,'y$','ies')
    else p||'s'
  end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.seo_slug(p text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case when p is null then null else
    trim(both '-' from regexp_replace(lower(p), '[^a-z0-9]+', '-', 'g'))
  end
$function$
